create_message_factory: create a MessageFactory instance with a custom DescriptorPool for building dynamic proto2 messages
get_prototype_message_class: build a proto2 message class from a descriptor using MessageFactory.GetPrototype
get_messages_from_files: get all message classes from specified proto files using MessageFactory.GetMessages
get_messages_from_file_protos: build a dictionary of message classes from an iterable of FileDescriptorProto objects using GetMessages
register_extension_on_message: register a protobuf extension on an extended message class using RegisterExtension
